parameters.name: action

get.description: List the caller's own notifications in the active organization. Sessions only (API keys are refused).

patch.summary: Mark a notification read or unread
patch.description: Mark one of the caller's own notifications read or unread. Another user's notification is 404.

get.description: Published plans with their entitlements; prices arrive with price books (S06). Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
A published plan; the same catalogue for every organization. Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
Plan limits and features with organization overrides applied; `source` says where each value comes from. Requires permission `org:read` in the active organization.
Postings on the organization own accounts (wallet etc.) with a running balance; platform accounts are never shown. Requires permission `billing:read` in the active organization.
Prepaid wallet balance per currency (projection of the ledger). Requires permission `billing:read` in the active organization.

Usage aggregates of the active organization by meter and resource over a time window (default: the current UTC month; at most 366 days). granularity=hour|day|month rolls up the stored buckets: month follows the billing period, day and hour follow the bucket (a meter stored per day is never split into hours). Every point carries its dataRegion. Requires permission `usage:read`.

Per meter for one UTC month (period=YYYY-MM, default current): quantity, allowance applied and the rated amount when rated. A total is given only when all rated lines share one currency. Requires permission `usage:read`.

Raw metering events of the active organization, newest window first. Requires permission `usage:events:read` (owner, admin, billing_admin). Rate limited per organization. (The platform-wide view for finance/support is not implemented yet.)

Consumption against the effective limits per meter group for the current UTC month. state is ok, soft or hard; a hard state blocks NEW consumption of that group only. Groups with no measuring meter are reported with measured=false, never as ok. Reading refreshes the projection and announces a newly crossed 80/100 percent threshold once. Requires permission `usage:read`.
Monthly caps of the organization and its projects. Requires permission `billing:read`.

put.summary: Create or replace a spending limit
put.description: Identified by scope (org|project) and projectId. Creating needs no precondition; replacing needs If-Match with the limit ETag (428 when missing, 412 when stale). A cap below the month spend (rated usage plus approved spend) is refused with 422 spend_approval_required. Project caps are evaluated against approved spend only until rated usage carries a project (M05). Requires permission `billing:manage`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the limit being replaced.

get.description: Approvers (permission `billing:manage`) see every request of the organization; other callers see their own. status filters pending, approved, denied or expired. Requires permission `spend:request`.

post.description: Asks approvers to allow spend above the limit for one quote or operation. Four-eyes applies above the organization threshold (always when none is set): the requester can never decide such a request. The request expires (default 24 h). One open request per subject. Requires permission `spend:request` (developer and above).

Approve or deny a pending request. Session only, requires a recent MFA verification (step-up) and is refused while impersonating. Under four-eyes the requester cannot decide (403). 409 when already decided or expired. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

post.summary: Create a quote (one endpoint for every kind)
post.description: Priced by the pricer registered for the kind from the price book version effective now (ai-credit today; plan answers kind_not_available until subscriptions exist in M03; other kinds until their milestone registers a pricer). The quote carries a provisional tax estimate, a not_evaluated residency block, and requiresApproval when the monthly spend cap would be exceeded. It is immutable once issued and valid until expiresAt (default 15 minutes). A hard quota the quote would exceed refuses it (quota_exceeded). Requires permission `quote:create`.

get.description: status is issued, or expired once expiresAt has passed (the stored quote never changes). Requires permission `quote:read` (owner, admin, billing_admin, developer).
Invoicing identity of the active organization (legal name ar/en, VAT and CR numbers, address, buyer type b2b/b2c). 404 until one is set. Requires permission `billing:read`.

put.summary: Create or replace the tax profile
put.description: Creating needs no precondition; replacing needs If-Match with the profile ETag (428 without, 412 when stale). Format rules (VAT/CR number, postal code, building number) are configuration marked [VERIFY] with the tax advisor; a b2b buyer needs a VAT number and a complete address. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the profile being replaced.

get.description: Issued invoices of the active organization, newest first (drafts are never stored). Filters status (open, partially_paid, paid, void, uncollectible), from and to (issue time). Requires permission `billing:read`.

Invoice with lines, tax breakdown, buyer and seller snapshots and the ZATCA status (not generated until the ZATCA module exists). An issued invoice never changes except its payment status. Requires permission `billing:read`.

The invoice as a PDF (A4), rendered from the immutable snapshot in Arabic (default, right-to-left) or English with ?lang=ar|en. Sandbox invoices carry a visible watermark. 503 when the PDF renderer is unavailable. Requires permission `billing:read`.

The stored e-invoice XML: the cleared XML of a standard (B2B) invoice, the stamped XML of a simplified one. SIMULATED environments only, not verified against ZATCA. 409 until there is one to give (e-invoicing off, not generated, not stamped, not cleared). Requires permission `billing:read`.
Credit notes of the active organization, newest first; ?invoice= filters by the original invoice. Requires permission `billing:read`.
Credit note with the credited lines and its original invoice. Requires permission `billing:read`.
Active methods of the organization, default first, with an expiring flag (expires within 60 days). Requires permission `billing:read`.

post.description: Saves a method from the setup token produced by the PSP hosted fields (provider + setupToken). Card numbers or any card data in ANY field are refused with 422 pan_not_allowed: the platform never receives card data. The first method becomes the default. Requires permission `billing:manage` (owner, billing admin).

delete.description: Detaches the method at the PSP and marks it removed (never deleted). 409 while a payment using it is in progress. The default passes to the newest other method. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

post.description: Requires permission `billing:manage`.

get.description: Newest first; filters status and invoice. Requires permission `billing:read`.

post.description: Starts a payment for an invoice with a saved method (default when paymentMethodId is omitted). An unfinished payment for the invoice is reconciled with the PSP first and returned: the PSP is never charged twice. 201 created, 202 while the outcome is not known yet, 200 when an existing payment is returned; status requires_action carries nextAction (3-D Secure redirect). Pays an invoice (invoiceId) or a wallet top-up (walletTopupId); quotes are not payable yet. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

get.description: An unfinished payment is refreshed from the PSP first, so a customer returning from 3-D Secure sees the truth even before the webhook arrives. Requires permission `billing:read`.
Newest first; filter by status. Requires permission `billing:read`.

post.description: Body {planVersionId, paymentMethodId, quantity?}. The plan fee is read from the price book and frozen on the subscription; a plan with no flat fee configured cannot be subscribed to (422). A payment method is required (422 payment_method_required). The first charge is invoiced and paid at once (status active), or a trial starts when a trial period is configured (once per organization); if the first payment does not succeed the subscription is past_due and the plan is not assigned until it is paid. One live subscription per organization (409). Requires permission `billing:manage`.

get.description: Requires permission `billing:read`.

patch.summary: Preview or apply a plan, quantity or payment-method change
patch.description: Body {planVersionId?, quantity?, paymentMethodId?, prorationMode?: prorate|none, preview?: boolean}. preview=true returns the proration (days left, unused credit, new charge, net) without changing anything and needs no If-Match. Applying needs If-Match with the subscription ETag (428 without, 412 when stale). prorate (default) switches now: a positive net is invoiced and paid at once, a negative net becomes a credit applied to the next renewal; none switches now with no charge or credit. A trialing subscription changes without proration. Only trialing or active subscriptions can change (409). Requires permission `billing:manage`.

post.summary: Cancel at the end of the paid period
post.description: Body {reason?}. The plan stays until the current period ends, then the subscription is cancelled and the organization returns to the default plan; nothing further is invoiced. Repeating the request changes nothing. 409 when already cancelled. Requires permission `billing:manage`.

Creates a top-up request and starts its payment with a saved method (default when paymentMethodId is omitted). The wallet is credited only when the payment is captured (ledger: PSP clearing to customer wallet, once). amount is {amount, currency} in minor units within the configured minimum and maximum. 201 created, 202 while the outcome is not known yet; requires_action carries nextAction (3-D Secure). VAT on prepaid credit is booked at consumption (policy D-25, awaiting tax-advisor confirmation). Requires permission `billing:manage`.

get.description: The CURRENT consent per (subject, purpose), newest first; history=true returns every row. Filters purposeId, subject, status (granted|withdrawn: the current state). A caller without `privacy:consent:manage` sees only their own subject (403 when asking for another). Requires permission `privacy:consent:self`.

post.description: Body {purposeId, granted: true, localeShown: ar|en, textVersion, subjectRef?}. APPEND-ONLY history: the grant is a new row. textVersion must be the CURRENT wording of the purpose (422 otherwise: show the current text first); an unknown purpose is 409 consent_purpose_unknown. Without subjectRef the subject is the caller (any member); subjectRef (an opaque id, never an email or name; "org" for the organization itself) needs `privacy:consent:manage` (owner, admin), else 403. Granting again with the same wording while already granted answers 200 with the existing record and writes nothing; 201 when a row was written. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `privacy:consent:self`. Audited. The purposes and their wording come from spec/compliance/purposes.yaml; the wording is a COUNSEL-TEXT-REQUIRED placeholder until HG-04-01.

200.description: Already granted with the same wording; existing record returned

delete.description: Records a `withdrawn` entry for the subject and purpose of the named record (the row is retained). Applies immediately: the next check sees it. Withdrawing something already withdrawn changes nothing. 404 for an unknown id, for another organization's, and for a member asking about someone else's record. Requires permission `privacy:consent:self` (acting for another subject needs `privacy:consent:manage`). Audited.

get.description: Newest first. Filters status, type, subject. A caller without `privacy:dsr:manage` sees only the requests about themselves. Each item carries slaState (ok, warning from 70% of the time, escalated from 90%, overdue) and its tasks. Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`.

post.description: Body {type: access|correction|deletion|portability, subjectRef?, details?: {text?, patch?}, identityAttestation?}. Without subjectRef the subject is the caller (verified by their session). A request about someone else (an end user of the organization) needs `privacy:dsr:manage` (owner, admin) and identityAttestation, how the identity was checked (10..500 characters), else 422 dsr_identity_unverified. A correction needs details.patch. Free-text details are SEALED (field encryption) and never returned (hasDetails only). 201 received with dueAt (calendar days per type, a PROPOSAL until counsel states the statutory deadlines, HG-04-01) and operationId; the request then runs as an operation: handlers export, rectify or erase per module, never bypassing a legal hold (legal_hold_active) or mandatory retention (retention_mandatory): those are refused with a recorded reason and the request is partially_fulfilled or rejected. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key (a replay returns the same request). Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`. Audited.

get.description: The request with its tasks (handler, action, status, reasonCode with Arabic and English wording), outcome and reason. For an access or portability request that finished, downloadUrl is a signed, expiring link: `?download=<token>` returns the encrypted-at-rest archive (application/gzip) of THIS request only (a token from another request is 404; 410 when the link or the archive expired), so a member can fetch their own data without the export permission. 404 for an unknown id, for another organization and for a member asking about someone else. Requires permission `privacy:dsr:self`.

get.summary: List data exports or download one
get.description: The exports (status, expiry, size, sha256, a signed downloadUrl while ready). With ?download=<token> returns the archive (application/gzip) of that link; 410 when the link or the archive has expired; the token is sealed and bound to the organization (a token of another organization is 404). Requires permission `privacy:export:manage`.

post.description: Body {scope: org|user, subjectRef?}. Asynchronous (an operation): 202 with the export pending; 200 on an Idempotency-Key replay. The archive is encrypted at rest in the export sink and downloaded through a signed, expiring link (archive 72 h, link 15 min by default). 422 no_export_sink when the deployment has no sink (production has none until M08, D-07); 422 quota_exceeded past 5 exports in progress. Requires permission `privacy:export:manage` (owner, admin). Audited.

get.summary: Get the organization's data residency policy
get.description: The effective policy: version 0 and isDefault true when the organization has set none (the default is in-Kingdom only), plus the platform FLOOR per data class (the loosest mode the platform ever allows; PROPOSAL, D-14/HG-04-01). Returns an ETag. Requires permission `privacy:residency:read` (every role).

put.summary: Set the organization's data residency policy (tighten only)
put.description: Body {mode: in_kingdom_only|allow_listed|unrestricted_with_assessment, allowedCountriesByClass, exceptions (ids of approved transfer assessments), changeNote?}. Versions are immutable; the first policy needs no precondition, a replacement needs If-Match (428 without, 412 when stale). The engine always applies the STRICTER of the mode and the platform floor of each class, and an organization may only tighten the floor: countries for a class the floor keeps in the Kingdom, or an assessment for such a class, are 422 policy_below_floor. Every exception must be an approved assessment that applies to this organization (an expired one is 422 assessment_expired). Requires permission `privacy:residency:manage` (owner, admin). Audited.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag of the current version; required when a policy already exists.

get.description: ONLY eligible inventory: account healthy, region verified (fresh, with evidence), plan available, capability supported, residency allows, entitlement and quota allow, price present. Any false hides the offer. Provider identity, provider region ids and provider cost are never returned (admin view: GET /v1/admin/offers). Behind the feature flag cloud.provisioning (404 while off). A 422 invalid_filter answers an unknown or admin-only filter. Requires permission `offers:read`.

The operating systems a customer can install on this offer, so a server is chosen by name instead of by an image id. Customer-safe: image id, display name and OS family only (no provider image reference). 404 when the offer is not eligible for the organization (the same rule as GET /v1/offers) or compute is not enabled. Behind the feature flag cloud.provisioning. Requires permission `offers:read`.
Instances of the active organization with status, data region, plan, public IPs, capabilities and drift state. Requires permission `compute:instance:read`.

post.summary: Create a compute instance from a quote
post.description: Consumes the compute quote (an M02 order: validity, quota group, spend limit or approved spend approval), records a cost-authorization hold for the first period, re-evaluates eligibility, residency, capability, quota and price at execution (TOCTOU) and starts a durable operation (202). Errors: 409 quote_expired|quote_consumed|price_changed, 422 spend_approval_required (with approvalId), 403 residency_denied, 422 quota_exceeded|unsupported_capability|no_eligible_offer. Requires permission `compute:instance:create` and an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: An id that belongs to another organization answers 404. Returns the ETag header used by DELETE If-Match. Requires permission `compute:instance:read`.

delete.description: Async (202 + operationId). Requires If-Match; 409 deletion_protected while protection is on; an instance whose state is uncertain is reconciled BEFORE the delete. Requires permission `compute:instance:delete`.

post.summary: Start, stop, reboot, resize or snapshot an instance
post.description: Body {type, params}. Only types in the instance capability set are accepted, otherwise 422 unsupported_capability (never a silent no-op); 409 invalid_state; idempotent per Idempotency-Key. resize takes params.offerId of an eligible plan in the same placement. Requires permission `compute:instance:act`.

get.summary: The control panel install of a server (HestiaCP) and its link state
get.description: Only for a server ordered with the panel installed automatically (404 otherwise). Staged status: create server, wait for boot, install panel, register link, readiness test, then ready or needs attention; a `held` order waits for provider capacity in the SOLD region (it is never moved to another one). `panelLink` is `lost` when Nuzm can no longer reach the panel (the customer has root); start/stop/restart go through the provider API and stay available. Requires permission `compute:instance:read`.

post.summary: Resume a panel install that needs attention (same server)
post.description: Never creates, replaces or wipes a server. Problems on Nuzm's side (readiness, DNS, node registration, secret store) continue from their stage; when the bootstrap did not finish on the server the registration window of the SAME order and server is extended and the response carries the command to re-run the script that is still on the server (`rerun_bootstrap`). A failed integrity check of the pinned installer is not resumable on that server (409 invalid_state). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `compute:instance:act`.

get.description: Series for a window (default the last hour, at most 7 days). 422 unsupported_capability when the provider exposes no metrics. Requires permission `compute:instance:read`.
Newest first; filters engine and status. Deleted databases are not listed. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

post.summary: Create a managed database or Redis instance
post.description: Body {quoteId (a quote of kind `database`), engine: postgresql|mysql|redis, version, name, network?: {access: private|allowlist, allowCidrs?}, backupPolicy?}. 202 with status `provisioning` and `operationId`: the order is placed from the quote (spend, quota and dunning checks of M02), the offer is re-derived NOW (enabled provider, available plan, verified region, supported version) and residency is evaluated (403 `residency_denied`). 422 `unsupported_capability` when no provider is enabled for the engine or the probe does not report it supported (nothing is ever mocked in production). 409 when the name is taken or the quote was used. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key; the provider call carries a deterministic token and an uncertain outcome is reconciled before any retry. The response carries a vault REFERENCE only, never a secret. Requires permission `data:db:write`. Audited.

get.description: State, endpoint {host, port}, `tlsRequired` (always true), network posture, `dataRegion`, `providerRegionId`, the vault REFERENCE of the connection secret (never the secret), backup policy, rotation window and the ETag. The provider and its account are never shown to customers. 404 for another organization. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

patch.description: Body {name?, backupPolicy?: {enabled?, retentionDays?, intervalHours?}, plan?}. Requires If-Match (428/412). `name` needs `data:db:write`; `backupPolicy` and `plan` need `data:db:admin`; the policy is bounded by the organization entitlements. `plan` (resize) answers 422 `unsupported_capability` unless the provider probe reports resize as supported: the action is disabled, never a silent no-op.

delete.description: The typed database name must be sent as `confirmName` (query or JSON body), else 422. 409 `in_use` while a site or app is bound to it (DatabaseBindingPort). 202 + operation: a final backup is taken per the backup policy (a failed final backup STOPS the deletion), then the instance is destroyed and its vault entry removed. Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.

get.summary: List backups with their restores and verification history
get.description: Newest first. Each backup lists the restores (and verification drills) made from it and the last verification result, which is how the console shows verification history. Requires permission `data:db:read`.

post.description: Body {type?: manual}. 202 + operation; the backup is stored in a system bucket of the database's own data region and carries size, SHA-256 checksum and a manifest of sampled tables. 409 unless the database is running; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot back it up (never faked). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `data:db:write`.

post.summary: Restore a database from a backup
post.description: Body {backupId, target?: new|inplace (default new), name?, confirmInPlace?, confirmName?, region?}. DEFAULT is restore-to-NEW in the same organization and provider region. `target=inplace` needs `confirmInPlace=true`, `confirmName` equal to the database name and a recent MFA verification (401 `step_up_required`), takes an automatic pre-restore backup first and answers 422 `restore_not_supported` when the provider cannot restore in place. A body that names another organization is 403; another organization's backup is 404; a region other than the source is checked against residency (403 `residency_denied`) and otherwise 422 `restore_not_supported`. The restored data is verified against the backup manifest: a mismatch fails the restore and raises an alert. 202 + operation. Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.

Body {role?}. 202 + operation. The NEW credential is issued while the old one keeps working, its secret goes to the vault, consumers are notified through DatabaseBindingPort and switch inside the window (proposal 24 h); at the window end the old credential is revoked. 409 `rotation_in_progress` while a rotation is pending or its window is open; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider has no dual-credential support (the action is disabled). Needs a recent MFA verification. The secret is never returned: the one-time reveal is PA-15 (not exposed until approved). Requires permission `data:db:admin`. Audited.

post.description: Body {name, quoteId (a quote of kind `storage`), region?, versioning?}. The bucket is named `nz-<orgShort>-<name>` (the namespace comes from the organization, never from input), PRIVATE by default (`public`, `policy` or an organization cannot be set here) and gets its own bucket-scoped credential stored in the vault. 202 + operation. 409 `name_taken` (the same answer whoever holds the name: names of other organizations cannot be enumerated); 422 `unsupported_capability` when no object-storage provider is enabled or the probe does not report buckets supported; 422 `quota_exceeded` beyond the entitlement bucket count; 403 `residency_denied`. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `data:storage:write`. Audited.

get.description: State, endpoint, `dataRegion`, `public`, versioning, quota, lifecycle, last usage (with which figures the provider could report), the vault REFERENCE of the bucket credential (never the secret) and the ETag. 404 for another organization, identical to a bucket that does not exist. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

patch.description: Body {quotaBytes}. Requires If-Match (428/412); bounded by the entitlement. Requires permission `data:storage:admin`.

delete.description: `confirmName` (query or JSON body) must equal the bucket name. An EMPTY bucket only (409 otherwise); `force=true` deletes the objects too and needs `data:storage:admin` plus a recent MFA verification. 202 + operation. Requires permission `data:storage:write`. Audited.

get.description: The policy document (deny-by-default subset) and its ETag. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

put.description: Body {policy: {version: 1, access: private|public-read, statements: [{effect: allow, actions, prefix, principal: bucket-credentials}], cors?}, confirmPublic?} (the policy may also be the body itself). Requires If-Match with the policy ETag. Only the documented subset is accepted: anything else is 422 `policy_invalid`. `access=public-read` needs `confirmPublic=true` (else 422 `policy_invalid`), a recent MFA verification, and is audited (`data.bucket.made_public`); the console shows a warning. Requires permission `data:storage:admin`.

post.description: Body {key, method: GET|HEAD|PUT|DELETE, ttlSeconds?}. Method-scoped: GET and HEAD need `data:storage:read`, PUT and DELETE also need `data:storage:write`. Default TTL 900 s, maximum 604800 s (7 days): 422 `ttl_too_long`. The URL is returned once and is never logged; the audit event carries a hash of the key. 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot sign. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

get.description: The rules and which actions the provider supports (expiry, multipart abort, transitions): unsupported actions are hidden by the console. Requires permission `data:storage:read`.

put.description: Body {rules: [{id, prefix, expireDays?, abortIncompleteMultipartDays?, transition?}]}. Expiry and multipart-abort need their capability; transitions only if the probe says so: otherwise 422 `unsupported_capability` (never a silent no-op). Requires permission `data:storage:write`.

get.description: Newest first, with the required records and their last checked status (ok, missing, conflict, unknown). Requires permission `email:read`.

post.description: Body {domain, purposes: [mailbox|transactional]}. 201 with the REQUIRED DNS records, declared by the enabled provider adapters (ownership, ONE merged SPF, DKIM selectors, MX for mailboxes, return-path) plus Nuzm's own ownership TXT (a token bound to this organization) and DMARC guidance (start `p=none`); state `pending`. 422 `unsupported_capability` when no provider is enabled for a purpose; 403 `residency_denied` when the provider's processing region is not allowed for personal data; 422 `domain_not_owned` when another account already VERIFIED the domain; 409 when this organization already added it. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`. Audited.

Body {apply?: boolean}. Looks every record up on SEVERAL resolvers (a majority decides; duplicate SPF, a wrong DKIM target or a foreign MX is a conflict), then asks the provider whether it verified the domain: `verified` needs both. `apply=true` writes the records through the M07 DNS zone (managed_by `email-verification`) when the domain is a Nuzm zone, else 422 `unsupported_capability` and the console shows manual instructions. If every resolver fails the state is unchanged and the retry comes sooner; otherwise the next automatic check follows the smallest TTL seen. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.

patch.description: Body {quotaMb}. Requires If-Match. 202 + operation; 422 `unsupported_capability` when the provider cannot change quotas. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`.

delete.description: 202 + operation; the provider mailbox is deleted and its vault entry removed. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`. Audited.

get.description: Newest first. Requires permission `email:read`.

post.description: Body {mailboxId, localPart}. 202 + operation; 409 when the address is already an alias or a mailbox. Requires permission `email:mailbox:manage`.

get.description: Newest first. Requires permission `email:read`.

post.description: Body {domainId, fromAddress}: a plain address of a domain this organization added for transactional email. `pending` until the domain verifies, then `verified`. Anti-spoofing: only a verified identity of the organization can be a sender. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.

get.description: Newest first; filter key. Requires permission `email:read`.

post.summary: Create a template or a new version
post.description: Body {key, name, locale: ar|en, subject, html, text?, variables?: {name: {type: string|number, required}}}. A new key is version 1; an existing key gets the NEXT version (versions are immutable). The HTML is sanitized with an allow-list (no script, handlers, styles or script URLs), every placeholder must be declared, the subject cannot contain line breaks, Arabic templates are RTL. Requires permission `email:template:write`.

get.description: Newest first; filters status, senderId. Metadata only: never recipients or content. Requires permission `email:read`.

post.description: Body {senderId, to[], templateId+variables | subject+html(+text), category: transactional}. Idempotency-Key is MANDATORY. 202 {id, status: queued}. Only `category=transactional` is accepted (422 `category_not_allowed`; marketing and bulk are blocked, as are more than 10 recipients); 422 `sender_not_verified`; 422 `suppressed` when any recipient is on the suppression list; 429 `rate_limited` (per-minute rate, warm-up allowance, auto-throttle at bounce rate above 5% or complaint rate above 0.1% over 24 h; proposals); 403 `residency_denied`; header injection and unsafe HTML are rejected or neutralized. The send is a durable operation: a replay is one provider call; the usage meter is emitted when the provider ACCEPTED the message, not when it was queued. Content is stored as a hash (sealed only for the queue buffer, or N days when the organization enabled retention); recipients are sealed. Requires permission `email:send`.

get.summary: Get a message with its event timeline
get.description: Status, counts, provider-acceptance time and the event timeline (sent, delivered, bounce, complaint, ...). 404 for another organization. Requires permission `email:read`.
Newest first; filters type, messageId. Events are append-only and carry no addresses or content. Requires permission `email:read`.
Newest first; filter active. Addresses are shown to the organization's own readers (sealed at rest). Requires permission `email:read`.

post.description: Body {address, action?: add|remove, override?}. Add (default) is a manual suppression, idempotent. Remove is audited; removing a hard bounce or a complaint needs `override=true`. Hard bounces and complaints are also added AUTOMATICALLY from provider webhooks. Requires permission `email:domain:manage`.

get.summary: List hosting plans that have capacity
get.description: Plan definitions (quotas, runtimes, price, region) offered to the organization: only plans with at least one eligible node region that has room AND that the data residency policy allows; plans without capacity are hidden. A plan price marked placeholder is not a published price. `/v1/offers?kind=hosting` is what can be bought now (SI-M06-2).

The runtime must be one the chosen node reports (422 unsupported_runtime). Needs Idempotency-Key. Audited.

get.description: Site with status, plan, data region, runtime, domains, quotas and usage summary; the ETag is the version for If-Match. An id of another organization is 404.

delete.description: Needs the header `X-Confirm-Delete: <siteName>`. Starts the offboarding operation: an export window (default 14 days, proposal) and then a verified wipe (files, database, user, vhost, certificates, cron, vault secrets); backups are kept until their retention expires. 409 legal_hold_active while a legal hold covers the site.

get.summary: List the domains of a site
get.description: Bindings with state pending|verified|active and, while pending, the verification record.

post.description: The first call for a domain creates a pending binding (201) and returns the verification record to publish; later calls re-check: verified -> 202 with the vhost operation, still unverified -> 422 ownership_unverified (with the record). A domain is unique among verified bindings across organizations (409 domain_in_use). Nothing unverified reaches the node. Needs Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: List the certificates of a site
get.description: Status, expiry, days to expiry, attempts and the last error code (never key material).

Needs Idempotency-Key.

post.description: 422 unsupported_capability until a database provider (M08) is enabled: never a silent no-op.

get.summary: List the backups of a site
get.description: Newest first; size, checksum, status and expiry (retention). Never keys or file content.

post.summary: Create a backup of a site
post.description: HestiaCP schedules the archive and uploads it to the node's remote backup host; the platform then finds it OFF the node in the store of the site's region and records its size and sha256 (residency checked, 403 residency_denied). Hestia documents no encryption of its archives: the `encrypted` flag of the backup says so. 422 no_backup_sink while no sink is configured (production waits for D-07 / P-M06-1), 422 quota_exceeded at the plan backup count/size limit. 202 + operation. Needs Idempotency-Key.

post.description: The link is HMAC-signed and bound to the organization, site and backup; it expires (default 5 minutes). Only an available backup. Another organization backup id is 404.

get.summary: Installation state of a site's Managed WordPress

post.description: Only a `failed` installation (409 otherwise). The retry resumes from what the site shows: an existing download, configuration, database or installation is kept, WP-CLI never overwrites them. 202 + operation. Needs Idempotency-Key.

post.description: Runs `wp user update` as the site user with a generated password and opens a NEW one-time handover (the old password may be lost or already used). Only a `ready` installation set up by the platform. 202 + operation. Needs Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Read the WordPress admin access ONCE
post.description: The one-time secure handover: the first successful call returns the admin username and the generated password and consumes them (the secret is deleted from the vault); a second call, parallel or later, is 409 (already used) and an unread handover expires after 7 days (410). The response is `Cache-Control: no-store`. Deliberately takes NO Idempotency-Key: an idempotency replay would keep the password. Audited.

get.description: Latest reported disk, inodes, monthly bandwidth, backup size and processes with the state (ok|soft|hard) of every quota. Soft threshold 80 % and hard 100 % of the plan limits (proposals).

Only verified registrar capabilities are used; a TLD outside the policy (every Saudi TLD today, HG-07-02) is listed as blocked without a vendor call. post.description: Body {quoteId, contacts:{registrant, admin?, tech?, billing?}, nameservers?, autoRenew?, privacy?}. The quote (kind domain, ONE register item) must be valid (409 quote_expired), eligible, and covered by the spend cap or an approved spend approval (403 approval_required); the wallet must cover it (402 payment_required: nothing is reserved). Funds are reserved in the ledger, the registrar is called through a platform operation with a deterministic token, the order is confirmed (ledger record, meter event) only after the registrar did. Registrant contacts are personal data: sealed at rest, residency-checked before they leave (403 residency_denied), and without privacy protection the consent domain_registrant_disclosure is required (422 consent_required). A taken name is 409 domain_unavailable. Answers 202 with operationId and the pending domain. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key and per quote. Requires domain:write. Audited.

Same funds, residency, consent and spend rules as an order. 202 with operationId and transferId. Requires domain:write. Audited.

patch.description: Body any of {contacts, nameservers, lock, autoRenew}; If-Match required. Fields the registrar cannot change are 422 unsupported_capability (never a silent no-op). Contacts are residency- and consent-checked. autoRenew is the PLATFORM's renewal flag (the vendor's own auto-renew stays off). 200 when applied, 202 with operationId when the registrar did not answer in time (reconciled). Requires domain:write. Audited.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: ETag (version) of the resource as read; stale = 412 etag_mismatch, missing = 428.

post.description: Body {quoteId (action renew), years}. Funds are reserved first (402), the spend cap applies (403 approval_required). A replayed run never extends the registration twice. 202 with operationId. Requires domain:renew (owner, admin, billing_admin). Idempotent. Audited.

post.description: ADDITION M07-ADD-2 (approved by the owner; needed by UI-M07-08 until M06 calls DnsLinkagePort itself). Body {siteId, apply?}. Without apply the response is a PREVIEW {outcome:preview, proposal:{records, changes, replaces, ssl}} built from the site's real targets (read through the M06 HostingSiteReadPort; an in-memory fake until M06 lands: NOT VERIFIED). With apply:true the records are written through the atomic DNS change-set as platform-managed (linkage) records and the approver is audited; applying again is {outcome:unchanged}. Requires domain:write and a DNS zone for the domain.

get.description: Requires dns:read.

post.summary: Create a DNS zone for a domain
post.description: Body {domainId}. DNS is hosted by the domain's registrar adapter only: without a supported dns capability the zone cannot be created (422 unsupported_capability; no Nuzm authoritative DNS in M07). Requires dns:write. Idempotent. Audited.

The whole set is validated first (422 record_invalid with errors[]: type rules, no CNAME at the apex or beside other records, TTL 60..86400, TXT chunking, SRV/MX/CAA fields, IDN, duplicates, quota). Then applied through the registrar's DNS adapter; when the adapter is not atomic the platform snapshots, applies, verifies by re-reading and rolls back on mismatch (zone marked degraded when the rollback is uncertain). Response: per-change results and the new ETag. 412 etag_mismatch. _acme-challenge and records pointing at Nuzm hosting are writable only through DnsLinkagePort. Requires dns:write. Audited (dns.changeset.applied|rolled_back).

Credits are a projection of the wallet (ledger account 2100) minus open reservations: `availableCredits = floor(wallet / creditUnitMinor) - reserved`. Usage by model and by project for the last 30 days. Requires permission `ai:read`.

Organization budget (daily credits, per-run credits/tokens, totals, alert thresholds, prompt-body logging, auto-apply) and project budgets. The ETag is the budget version (`"0"` = never set). Requires permission `ai:read`.

Enabling `autoApplyLowRisk` also needs `ai:write` (owner, admin, developer). Audited (`ai.budgets.updated`). Requires permission `ai:budgets:write`.

post.description: Body {title, projectId?}. A session holds the conversation and its runs; message bodies are stored sealed. Requires permission `ai:write`. Audited (`ai.session.created`).

post.description: Body {content, attachments?: [{kind:url,url}|{kind:text,name,text}]}. The content passes the moderation hook (422 `content_blocked`, placeholder deny-list: the policy is an owner decision) and the secret scan (422 `secret_detected`) BEFORE anything is stored. Attachments are references: URLs are fetched later by the SSRF-safe fetcher inside a run, and everything enters prompts only inside delimited data blocks. Requires permission `ai:write`.

get.description: Newest first, optionally for one session or project. Requires permission `ai:read`.

post.description: Body {sessionId, kind: website|edit|chat|webapp|test-fix|mobile, projectId?, input, budget?: {maxTokens, maxCredits}}. 202 with the run and its operation. `webapp` (the 7-agent graph; `input: {brief: {prompt}, maxMinutes?, specRef?}`, needs a web-app project, served only while the org flag `app_builder.enabled` is on) and `test-fix` (bounded debugging loop) are registered by the app-builder module (M10A). `mobile` (M10B, flag `mobile_builder.enabled`) needs a project of type mobile and input {description: 3..600 characters}: the design agent returns a structured mobile spec, a human approves it (approval kind `plan`), then the Flutter project is written as a new project version. Model quality is NOT VERIFIED. A webapp run that needs a human (destructive migration, dependency outside the policy, ...) waits in `waiting_approval` and is decided in the approvals inbox (`/v1/ai/approvals`; `pendingApproval.scopeHash` is the hash to quote), not through `POST /v1/ai/runs/{id}/approvals`. 402 `insufficient_credits`, 429 (too many active runs), 403 `residency_denied`, 422 `unsupported_capability` (no provider enabled), 503 `ai_unavailable` (kill switch), 409 `run_active` (one active run per session and per project). Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires permission `ai:write`. Audited (`ai.run.created`). A webapp run with input {builderLifecycle: true, brief: {prompt: 1..4000 characters}, maxRepairRounds?: 1..3, maxMinutes?: 1..60} runs the builder agent loop: it analyses the brief, plans, writes the plan's files as ONE validated change (AI branch only), reviews, builds and tests through the Execution Gateway, repairs failures within hard limits (3 repair rounds, 2 attempts per step on a transient error, 60 steps, the run's token and credit budget) and ends by asking for a deployment approval (approval type production_deploy, decided by an owner or admin in the approvals inbox). It deploys nothing. Served only while the organization flags builder_tools.enabled and builder_lifecycle.enabled are on (otherwise the run ends unsupported_capability). Build and test results are SIMULATED (a mock execution port) until the sandbox runtime is approved (D-21, HG-10-02, the Execution Gateway ADR); the result says so (simulated: true). 422 validation_failed for a malformed input; the usual 402/403/422/429/503 of run creation.

get.description: State (queued, running, waiting_approval, succeeded, failed, cancelled, budget_exceeded), step, usage and cost, the pending approval if any, artifact ids. 404 for another organization.

get.summary: Get an artifact of a run
get.description: Artifact payloads (requirements, architecture, page, change_set, site_model) are immutable JSON validated against their schema.

Server-sent events `{seq,type,data,at}` with `id: <seq>`; persisted, so a dropped client resumes with `Last-Event-ID`. The stream ends when the run is finished or waits for an approval (reconnect after the decision), or after 120 s. Requires permission `ai:read`.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this event sequence number

post.description: A queued or waiting run is cancelled at once; a running run is flagged and stops at its next step (the model call in flight is aborted and its reservation released). 409 `invalid_state` when the run is already finished. Audited (`ai.run.cancelled`).

post.summary: Approve or deny a pending run approval
post.description: Body {approvalId, decision: approve|deny, note?}. Approval kinds: plan, apply_changes, publish, delete, spend, auto_apply; each is bound to the run and to the SHA-256 of the exact action and expires (24 h proposal): 409 `approval_expired`. The approver is a person signed in (a session, never an API key) who holds `ai:approve` (403 otherwise); there is no AI identity in this path. The audit event names that person. Approve starts the next run segment; deny cancels the run unless the kind has its own handler. Audited (`ai.approval.granted|denied`).

get.summary: Whether a billing administrator may read project content through the builder tools
get.description: Answers {mode: allow|deny, default: allow}. allow (the default) = today: a billing administrator reads the review, symbols, import analysis, components and memory of a project. Permission org:read.
Newest first, with the last deployment. Requires permission `builder:read`.

post.summary: Create a website, web-app or mobile project
post.description: Body {type: website|webapp|mobile, name, locale: [ar|en…], templateId?}. `webapp` (M10A) creates the project row only: no head version, `siteModel: null`, until the first generation run; website-only surfaces (previews, forms, CMS, restoration) answer 422 `unsupported_capability` for it and `POST …/changes` is the safe-diff patch set of the web-app pipeline (`{baseVersion, patches[], message?}`). Website: Starts from one of the bilingual templates or an empty site and creates version 1 with its rendered files. 422 `quota_exceeded` beyond the project limit, 403 `residency_denied`, 409 `name_taken`. Requires permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.project.created`). The whole builder surface answers 404 while the `ai.enabled` flag is off. `type=mobile` (M10B) creates an empty Flutter project (version 1, no files) and needs the `mobile_builder.enabled` flag (404 otherwise); site-model operations (changes, restoration) and previews refuse mobile projects with 422 `unsupported_capability`: a web preview of a Flutter app is not available yet and would never be a guarantee of device behaviour.

get.summary: Get a project with its site model
get.description: The project, the site model of the head (or `versionId`), the SEO score report of that model and, with `compareTo`, the diff between two versions. The ETag is the project version (If-Match for PATCH). 404 for another organization.

patch.description: Only `name` can change (locales are fixed in v1). 412 `etag_mismatch`, 428, 409 `name_taken`. Audited.

delete.description: `confirmName` (query or body) must equal the project name: a human typed it, which is the approval of this destructive action. The project is soft-deleted for the retention window (30 days proposal), its previews stop working. 409 `in_use` while a deployment is in progress. Audited (`builder.project.deleted`).

get.summary: List the rendered files of a version
get.description: Path, size, mime and SHA-256 of every generated file of the head (or `versionId`).
Text files as UTF-8, binary files as base64; 413 `payload_too_large` above 1 MiB.

post.summary: Apply an ordered set of editor operations
post.description: Body {baseVersion, ops[], source: user, label?, assetData?}. Ops: insertComponent, updateProps, moveComponent, deleteComponent, setTokens, setText, addPage, deletePage, updatePage, setSeo, setNav, addAsset, removeAsset. Validated against the schema, applied atomically, answered with the SAFE DIFF (structural + rendered-text changes), risk flags (deletes_page, deletes_component, changes_seo, changes_slug, …), the new version and the INVERSE ops (undo). 409 `base_outdated` carries rebase info (head version, changed pages); 422 `op_invalid` lists the issues. Empty `ops` with a `label` names the current version. `source=ai` answers 403 `approval_required`: AI change sets are applied only through a run approval. Single writer per project (row lock, ETag). Audited (`builder.change.applied`).

post.summary: Dry-run a change set or a unified diff
post.description: Body {baseVersion?, patches[] | diff}: exactly one of `patches` (whole-file ops add|modify|delete|rename, the shape of the web-app change set) or `diff` (a unified diff). Nothing is stored. Answers the per-file unified diffs, totals, risks, `approval.required` (many deletions, applied migrations, pipeline files, very large change) and the whole-file ops a diff turned into. 409 `base_mismatch` when baseVersion is not the head, 422 `change_rejected` for a diff that does not apply. Web-app and mobile projects only. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off).

get.summary: Diff two versions of a web-app project
get.description: Query from, to (version ids). Same view as a preview: per-file unified diffs from `from` to `to`. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled`.

post.summary: Roll a web-app project back to an older version
post.description: Body {targetVersion, baseVersion?, confirmed?}. Creates a NEW head version (`source: restore`) whose files equal the target; history is never rewritten. Every safety check of the change pipeline runs again. 409 `conflict` when the target is the head or equals it, 409 `base_mismatch` when baseVersion is stale, 422 `change_rejected` when the change needs a human confirmation and `confirmed` is not true. Audited (`builder.change.rolled_back`). Permission `builder:write`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled`.

post.summary: Undo one earlier change, keeping later work
post.description: Body {versionId, baseVersion?, confirmed?}: undoes `versionId` against its parent; files edited since are LEFT ALONE and returned in `conflicts`. 409 `conflict` when nothing can be reverted safely. Audited (`builder.change.reverted`). Permission `builder:write`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled`.

post.summary: Plan a product from a requirement text
post.description: Body {text (at most 20000 characters), hint?: product type, repairRounds?: 0 to 3}. Pure and local: the text is analysed with fixed Arabic and English keyword tables and is never sent to a model or a vendor, so no credit is spent and no residency decision applies. Answers the validated implementation plan (tasks in stages with files, acceptance criteria and approvals), the open questions and an ESTIMATE of tokens and cost in integer minor units (a planning figure, not a quote). Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off).

get.summary: Static review of the head version
get.description: Findings of the static review (unbalanced brackets, invalid JSON, secrets, unresolved imports, install scripts, undeclared packages) with stable codes; a finding never quotes file content. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off). Web-app and mobile projects only.

Query q (1 to 100 characters), kind? (function, class, const, type, interface, enum). Best match first, at most 20 results. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off). Web-app and mobile projects only.

Unresolved imports, packages used but not declared, declared but unused dependencies and import cycles of the head version. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off). Web-app and mobile projects only.

Exported UI components of the head version ranked by how many files import the file that defines them. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off). Web-app and mobile projects only.

Short notes about the project (decisions, conventions, preferences, facts, known issues) kept in the project file `nuzm.memory.json`. Permission `builder:read`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled` (404 when off). Web-app and mobile projects only.

post.description: Body {kind: decision, convention, preference, fact or issue; text (at most 400 characters); pinned?; baseVersion?}. Written as the signed-in person through the safe-change pipeline (a new project version and Git commit on `main`). A note with a secret is refused (422 `validation_failed`); an identical note is not added twice (`change: null`). 409 `conflict` when the stored memory file is damaged (it is never overwritten). Audited (`builder.memory.changed`). Permission `builder:write`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled`.

delete.description: Removes the note through the safe-change pipeline (a new project version). 404 `not_found` for an unknown note. Audited (`builder.memory.changed`). Permission `builder:write`. Flag `builder_tools.enabled`.

get.description: Newest first; history is immutable. `isHead` marks the current head.

post.description: Creates a NEW head version from the chosen one; history is never rewritten. 409 `conflict` when the version already is the head. Audited (`builder.version.restored`).

get.description: Ids, versions and expiry; never a usable URL.

post.description: Body {viewport?: mobile|tablet|desktop, versionId?}. Returns an unguessable URL (160-bit token in the host name) on the ISOLATED preview origin, a different registrable domain from the console and the API, expiring (30 min proposal). The token is shown only here. 429 beyond the active-preview limit.

get.description: Forms of the project (those of the site model are registered automatically) with submission and blocked-spam counts and the public endpoint.

post.description: Body {formKey, name, fields: [{name, type: text|email|tel|textarea, required?}], notifyEmail?, retentionDays?}. The notification address is stored sealed. 409 `name_taken`.

get.description: Class `personal`, stored sealed. Roles without `builder:submissions:read` (viewer) get every value masked; unmasked reads are audited.
Typed collections with their items and publish state.

post.summary: Create a collection and/or add items
post.description: Body {collectionKey, name?, fields?, items?: [{data, state?: draft|published}]}. A new collection needs name and fields (text, number, boolean, date, localized_text); items are validated against them. Only PUBLISHED items are consumed by a build (sections with `props.collection`).

get.description: Newest first.

post.summary: Publish a project to a hosting site
post.description: WEB-APP projects (M10A) are dispatched to the app-builder pipeline: body {projectId, versionId?, target: {type: site, id}, env: production|staging}; a production target needs hash-bound approvals decided in the approvals inbox (403 `approval_required` with `approvals[{id,type,scopeHash}]`, then repeat the same request), the build runs in a sandbox, only the static `public/` front end is published through the hosting publish port (the Node back end and the database migrations have no compute path yet: NOT VERIFIED live), a failed health gate restores the previous release; a `site` target is a hosting site of the organization (404 otherwise; `instance` targets have no publish path). Website projects: body {projectId, target: hostingSiteId, environment: production|staging, approvalId?}. Needs a human PUBLISH approval bound to the exact version, target and environment: the first call answers 403 `approval_required` with `approvalId` and the cost disclosure; repeat with that `approvalId` and a NEW Idempotency-Key to confirm. Then build → stage → smoke (HTTP 200 on every page, TLS) → switch → live smoke; a failed smoke check rolls back automatically. 404 for another organization site, 409 (one deployment in flight per target), 422 `unsupported_capability` (no publish path: live publish needs a real hosting node, HG-05-01/02, HG-06-01). A production publish is confirmed by a role in `productionPublishRoles` (default owner, admin, developer); another role gets 403 `forbidden` with `policy` and `allowedRoles` and the approval stays pending for an allowed role to confirm. Audited (`deploy.deployment.*`).

get.summary: Read the deployment policy of the organization
get.description: The switches for owner decisions O-1 (`productionPublishRoles`: who may confirm a production publish of a website) and O-2 (`rollbackRequiresOwnApproval`). `source` is `default` when the organization never set one (the defaults equal the behaviour before the switches existed).
State (queued, building, deploying, smoke_checking, succeeded, failed, rolled_back), artifact hash, smoke results, URL, error.
Append-only log lines `{seq, level, message, data, at}`.

post.summary: Roll back to the previous artifact
post.description: Restores the artifact that served before this deployment (its artifact hash) and creates a new deployment with `rollbackOf`. 409 `invalid_state` unless the deployment succeeded and has a predecessor. When the organization policy `rollbackRequiresOwnApproval` is on, a PRODUCTION rollback answers 403 `approval_required` with an `approvalId`; repeat the request with that id in the body (a signed-in person whose role is in `productionPublishRoles`) to confirm it. The approval is bound to this rollback and single use.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running deployment
post.description: A queued deployment is cancelled at once (state `cancelled`). A running one is flagged and stops at its next checkpoint (before the build, before staging, before the switch): the staged upload is discarded and the live site is never touched. Once the site has been switched the request is accepted but has no effect (the deployment ends `succeeded`; use rollback). 409 `invalid_state` for a finished deployment. 422 `unsupported_capability` for a web-app deployment (the app builder pipeline has no cancel yet). Audit: `deploy.deployment.cancelled`.

get.description: Connections of the organization with their email domains and DNS TXT proof status (txtName/txtValue while pending), JIT policy, enforcement flag and the signing-certificate count (never the certificates or any secret). Requires org:security. Feature flag enterprise.sso.

post.summary: Create or update an SSO connection
post.description: CREATE {protocol: saml|oidc, name, domains[], jit?{enabled, defaultRole viewer|developer|billing_admin}, xml|metadataUrl (saml) or issuer, clientId, clientSecretRef=vault://… (oidc)}: SAML metadata must declare a signing certificate (422 invalid_sso_metadata), a domain verified by another organization is 409 domain_claimed, a secret VALUE is refused (422 credential_value_rejected). Each domain needs a DNS TXT record _nuzm-sso.<domain> = nuzm-sso-verification=<token>; a platform job verifies it (read from the organization's own Nuzm zone first, then public DNS). UPDATE {connectionId, enforce?, jit?, idpInitiated?, enabled?, domains?}: enforce=true needs an active connection with a verified domain AND a successful test login (the test login endpoint is not approved yet, SCR-M12-05, so enforcement cannot be turned on in production until it is). Enforcement blocks password and platform-IdP sign-in for the verified domains (403 sso_required). JIT never grants owner/admin. IdP-initiated SAML is off unless idpInitiated=true. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Requires org:security and a recent MFA step-up. Audited (sso.connection.created|enforced).

get.description: Newest first; filter status. Requires permission `automation:read`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

post.description: Body {name, definition, triggers[]}. The definition is a JSON DAG (steps http_request, nuzm_api, send_email, start_ai_run, create_deployment, delay, condition, bounded loop, transform) validated against the schema, with every expression parsed by the restricted expression language (no eval, no code), literal credentials refused, and every connector reference checked to be authorized in the organization: 422 `validation_failed` with errors[] (schema, cycle, unauthorized connector). Triggers: schedule (cron + IANA zone), webhook (the secret URL and HMAC secret are returned ONCE), platform_event (allow-listed outbox topics) and manual. The workflow starts as `draft`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

get.summary: Get a workflow with its active definition and versions
get.description: Returns the active version's definition and the version list; ETag header. Another organization's workflow answers 404.

patch.summary: Rename, activate, pause or disable a workflow
patch.description: PATCH changes `name` and `status` only (the definition changes through versions). `If-Match` is required (412 `etag_mismatch`). Activating needs a published version; an administrator pause cannot be lifted by the organization (403); a disabled workflow stays disabled.

post.description: Body {definition, notes?}. Versions are immutable (a database trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE); an identical definition returns the current version with `unchanged: true`. The new version becomes the active one; running executions keep the version they started with. 422 for an invalid definition or an unauthorized connector.

get.summary: List the executions of a workflow
get.description: Newest first; filter status.

post.description: Body {versionId?, input, dedupeKey}. 202 with the execution and its durable operation (`operationId`). A repeated dedupeKey answers 200 with the ORIGINAL execution and `duplicate: true` (never a second run). 429 `rate_limited` when the plan quota or the per-minute start rate is exhausted; 409 `invalid_state` for a paused or disabled workflow. Idempotency-Key is required. Requires permission `automation:run`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

get.summary: Get an execution with its steps, attempts, redacted logs and dead letters
get.description: Steps carry per-attempt status, idempotency flag, input and output (secrets removed before storage), errors; `deadLetters` lists failed steps with their replay state. Another organization's execution answers 404.
Newest first, with the authorization state (never a vault reference). Requires permission `connector:manage`.

post.description: Body {type: nuzm|http|oauth2|email, name, scopes[], rateLimit?: {perMinute, burst}, config}. Only first-party, generic HTTP, generic OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE) and email connectors exist; named third-party connectors are out of scope. URLs in the config are checked by the SSRF policy (422 `ssrf_denied`); a body that carries a credential value is refused (422 `credential_value_rejected`). Requires permission `connector:manage`.

Body {kind: credential, vaultRef, scopes?, expiresAt?} stores a reference to a secret of THIS organization (vault://…/tenant-<orgId>-…; any other reference or a raw value is 422 `credential_value_rejected`); {kind: oauth2_start, redirectUri} returns the authorization URL with PKCE (S256) and state; {kind: oauth2_complete, state, code} exchanges the code at the tenant-supplied token endpoint through the SSRF-guarded client. Granted scopes can never exceed the connector's declared scopes (403 `connector_not_authorized`).

get.description: Newest first; secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Create an outbound webhook endpoint (or rotate its secret)
post.description: Body {url, events[], description?, secretRotation?: {overlapHours}}. The URL must be https and public (422 `ssrf_denied` for private, loopback, link-local, metadata and rebinding targets). The signing secret (`whsec_…`) is shown ONCE. Deliveries carry `X-Nuzm-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac>` = HMAC-SHA256(secret, `<t>.<body>`) (receivers must reject timestamps older than 5 minutes and dedupe on `X-Nuzm-Event-Id`); failed deliveries retry on an exponential schedule for up to 24 hours, then are dead-lettered. Sending `secretRotation` for an existing URL rotates the secret: both secrets sign during the overlap. The delivery log read and the replay route are SCR-M11-02 (not exposed).

get.description: Default: published listings with APPROVED versions only (artifact references and scan findings are never shown). `mine=true`: the publisher's own listings in every state with all versions, scan findings and the revenue accrual summary (accrued, not paid out). `filter[id]` returns one listing (the detail view) with a provisional VAT estimate. Filters: type, q. Requires permission `marketplace:read`. The dedicated detail GET is SCR-M11-03 (not exposed).

post.summary: Create a listing (and its first version)
post.description: Body {type: website-template|app-template|workflow-template, title: {ar, en}, description?: {ar, en}, price: {amount, currency}, licence: single_org|multi_seat, seats?, artifactRef?, sbomRef?, version?}. The organization must be a VERIFIED publisher (403 `publisher_not_verified`; an unverified account is registered for the ops verification step). A submitted version is hashed, scanned (secrets, malware signatures, dependencies, personal data, licence, SBOM, workflow schema) and enters moderation as `pending`: it is neither listed nor purchasable until a person approves it. The artifact reference must lie inside the publisher's own namespace. Requires permission `marketplace:publish`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.
Body {version (semver), artifactRef, sbomRef?, changelog?}. Immutable once stored; hashed and scanned at submission; enters moderation as `pending`. 409 for a duplicate version string.

post.summary: Purchase a listing from a quote
post.description: Body {listingId, versionId?, quoteId} where the quote has kind `marketplace` (POST /v1/quotes). The quote becomes an order (spend limits and quotas apply) and an invoice through M03; the buyer pays the invoice with POST /v1/billing/payments (or at once with the default payment method). The entitlement is `pending` until the invoice is PAID, then `active`, and the publisher's share is ACCRUED on the ledger (account 2600; never paid out: D-26 open). 202 while payment is pending, 200 when paid. 409 `already_entitled`, 409 `not_purchasable`, 409 `price_changed`, 409 `quote_expired`, 409 `quote_conflict`, 402 `payment_required` when the immediate payment is declined (the invoice stays open), 403 `residency_denied`. A repeated request (same quote) returns the same purchase: exactly one order, invoice, entitlement and accrual. Requires permission `marketplace:buy`.

get.description: Brings the purchase up to date with its invoice first (payment webhooks update the invoice; a refund shows as a credit note and revokes the entitlement). Another organization's purchase answers 404.
The organization's own installations, newest first.

post.description: Body {listingVersionId, workspaceId?}. Requires an ACTIVE entitlement of the SAME organization whose version range covers the version (403 `not_entitled` otherwise, whatever the listing or version); the install is a COPY owned by the buyer (a new workflow or builder project with a new id). Website and app templates need the builder (M09/M10) and a workspace: 422 `unsupported_capability` where it is not wired. 403 `residency_denied`; 409 when already installed. Requires permission `marketplace:install`.

get.summary: Get the agency profile of the organization and the agencies linked to it
get.description: For an agency organization: its own profile (`role: agency`). For any other organization: the agencies that hold a link to it (`role: client`).

post.summary: Create the agency profile of the current organization
post.description: The organization must be of type `agency`. One profile per organization (409). Requires permission `agency:manage`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

get.description: The agency sees all its links; a client sees its own.

post.summary: Invite a client (agency) or answer an invitation (client)
post.description: Agency side (the agency's own organization, `agency:manage`): body {clientOrgId} creates a link in `pending_acceptance` (status `pending`). Client side (a linked organization, `partners:manage`): body {linkId, decision: accept|decline}; ONLY the client can accept, and an unknown client id stays pending (no existence oracle). 409 for a duplicate live link. The caller's organization decides the side; a stranger gets 404. Revocation is SCR-M11-01 (not exposed).

get.description: The agency sees all its grants; a client sees the grants made to it. A grant past its expiry shows as `expired`.

post.summary: Propose a delegated-access grant (agency) or answer it (client)
post.description: Agency side (`agency:manage`): body {clientOrgId, scopes[], expiresAt} needs an ACTIVE link; scopes come from the delegable catalogue (never billing, members, keys, privacy, audit, partner programs, deletion); `expiresAt` is MANDATORY and at most 365 days away (422 when missing or too far). Client side (`partners:manage`): {grantId, decision: accept|decline}; an accepted grant never exceeds the scopes the accepting administrator holds. Scopes and expiry never change after creation. Acting with a grant: `X-Nuzm-Acting-Org` on delegable routes; effective permissions = intersection(agency member role, grant scopes); every request is re-validated (no cache). Revocation is SCR-M11-01 (not exposed).

get.summary: Get the reseller profile (or the reseller of a linked sub-organization)
get.description: For a reseller organization: its own profile (`role: reseller`); for a linked sub-organization: the reseller it belongs to (`role: sub_organization`), read only.

post.summary: Create the reseller profile of the current organization
post.description: The organization must be of type `reseller`. Requires permission `reseller:manage`. Default OFF: 403 `feature_disabled` until the flag is on for the organization.

get.description: The reseller sees its links (with the organization name for active ones); a sub-organization sees its own link.

post.summary: Link a sub-organization (reseller) or answer the link (sub-organization)
post.description: Reseller side (`reseller:manage`): body {subOrgId, priceBookRef?} links an EXISTING organization (pending); the sub-organization's administrator answers {linkId, decision: accept|decline}. Creating a brand-new sub-organization is NOT available (422 `unsupported_capability`): who owns it afterwards is an open product/legal decision. An organization belongs to one reseller at a time (409). A reseller sees aggregates and metadata only, never sub-organization content.

get.summary: Get the current price rule set and its history
get.description: The rule set is versioned and append-only; the ETag is the current version (0 when none). Reseller only (a sub-organization gets 404). Requires permission `reseller:pricing`.

put.summary: Replace the price rule set with a new version
put.description: Body {rules: [{scope: plan|meter, scopeKey, markup: {type: percent, bps} | {type: fixed, amountMinor, currency}, effectiveFrom}]}. `If-Match` = the current version (412 `etag_mismatch`, 428 when missing). effectiveFrom must be at least one day away (422); a negative markup would sell below the wholesale cost: 422 `below_cost`. Money is integer minor units. Requires permission `reseller:pricing`.

get.summary: Get a reseller statement for a period (JSON or CSV)
get.description: ?period=YYYY-MM (default: the previous month), ?format=csv. Per sub-organization and meter: wholesale cost (the platform's own rating), retail (the price rule in force at the end of the period), margin, a provisional VAT estimate, and the ledger figure for the same organizations (variance). A closed period is stored once and never changes. The statement carries the invoice-issuer model: `disabled` / BLOCKED while D-24 is open (no retail invoice exists). Requires permission `reseller:finance`.

get.summary: List the sandboxes of a project
get.description: Newest first (50). A project of another organization is 404. Permission `sandbox:use`.

post.summary: Create a sandbox for a web-app project
post.description: Body {profile?: "standard", ttlMinutes?}. Starts an isolated runtime for untrusted generated code. 202 with the sandbox (`runtime.kind` and `runtime.isolation` say what really runs it: until D-21/HG-10-02 it is NEVER `verified`). Residency of the node region is evaluated first (403 `residency_denied`); 402 `budget_required` without credit; 409 `sandbox_quota_exceeded` (5 concurrent per organization); 503 `sandbox_no_capacity`; 422 `unsupported_capability` for a non-web-app project. Idempotent per Idempotency-Key. Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited (`sandbox.sandbox.created`). The terminal WebSocket and its ticket route need owner approval (PA-M10-01) and are not exposed.

get.description: State, quotas, egress profile, runtime label and lifetime. Another organization's sandbox is 404. Permission `sandbox:use`.

delete.description: Terminates the runtime (the record stays, state `terminated`). Idempotent. Permission `sandbox:use`. Audited (`sandbox.sandbox.terminated`).

post.summary: Start a live preview of a web-app project
post.description: Runs the newest application spec, rendered by the trusted generator (model-authored code is not run), as a child process with an in-memory store, sample data and a demo administrator, on the isolated preview origin `<token>.<previewDomain>`. Returns the address to frame (the one-time demo session is in the URL fragment) and when the preview stops (30 minutes). A new preview replaces the project's previous one. 403 `feature_disabled` unless flag `app_builder.live_preview` is on; 404 when nothing was built yet; 429 `rate_limited` (2 per organization); 503 `service_unavailable` when previews are busy or the preview did not start; 422 `unsupported_capability` in production (needs a sandbox: HG pending). Permission `builder:write`. Audited (`builder.webapp_preview.started`). ADR-063.

Vendored third-party code needs the `export_third_party` approval (403 `approval_required`). 403 `residency_denied`. Permission `builder:export`. Audited (`builder.export.created`).

post.description: Body {projectId, versionId?, platform: android|ios, profile: debug|release}. 202 with the queued build; it runs on a build worker. iOS answers 503 `no_macos_capacity` (no macOS capacity exists: D-22 / HG-10-01, never simulated). A `release` profile needs a signing credential REFERENCE authorized by an owner/admin (422 `signing_not_authorized`) and a connected signing stage (503 `signing_unavailable`; none exists, HG-10-01). 503 `build_runner_unavailable` when no worker exists (production until D-21). A development runner, when enabled, builds an UNSIGNED debug APK and is NOT isolated: the build record says so. 422 for a version without a generated Flutter project. Metered as `mobile.build_minutes` (dimension platform). Requires permission `mobile:build`. Audited (`mobile.build.requested`, `mobile.build.finished`). Answers 404 while the `mobile_builder.enabled` flag is off.

post.description: Body {platform: android|ios, label, vaultRef: vault://…, authorizedBy: the caller}. VAULT REFERENCES ONLY: any other member, and any value that looks like key material, a password, a token or a PEM block, is 422 `raw_secret_rejected` and is never echoed or logged. Owner and admin roles only (`mobile:signing`). 409 for an active credential with the same label. Audited (`signing.credential.authorized`, without the reference). Revocation has no path in docs/04 yet (SCR-M10B-01).

post.description: Body {projectId, buildId, versionName, versionCode, store: google_play|app_store, checklist?, metadata?, status?: draft|prepared}. The record PREPARES a store release; Nuzm does not submit to any store and cannot predict a store review. `draft` keeps what is entered and returns `missing`; `prepared` needs every checklist item (privacy-policy https URL, permission declarations matching the app, 2+ screenshots per locale, compliance items, listing metadata) and a SIGNED succeeded build, else 422 `release_checklist_incomplete` naming each item. Text that promises store approval or a way around store review is 422. 409 for a duplicate store and version code. The owner-approval step, read-by-id and the submission-preparation export need new paths: SCR-M10B-02 (not registered). Requires permission `mobile:release`. Audited (`mobile.release.created`).
