Never file contents, paths or object keys. Text search is over the published metadata, Arabic or English. Requires `builder:read`. 404 while the flag `knowledge.customer_templates` is off.
A published template. A resource that is not active, published, licence-eligible and reuse-permitted is 404, indistinguishable from a missing one. Requires `builder:read`.

post.description: The recommendation engine (S-K5) answered for a customer: hard filters first, then the weighted model over eligible templates only, then the strategy. A user's choice is honoured or explained, never substituted; an unusable choice that the customer may not see is reported as not found. Nothing is returned about resources the customer may not see (no exclusion list, no document text, no paths). Records the customer's own usage events for the top results. Requires `builder:read`.

post.summary: Start a project from a template
post.description: Copies the pinned, immutable version of a published template into a NEW web-app project of the organization through the safe-change pipeline (path, secret and canary checks, size limits, dependency policy, one Git commit). The template is never modified. Eligibility is re-checked for the adaptation mode (default ADAPTIVE) at copy time: an unusable template answers `knowledge_template_incompatible` (409) with the reasons, a changed template 409. Binary and unstored files are not copied and are listed. Records the customer's usage events, a link from the project to the pinned version, and the audit event `knowledge.template.copied`. Requires `builder:write`; needs `app_builder.enabled` and `knowledge.customer_templates`.

Records the requirement and the deterministic template selection for a project of the organization. Executing the plan (generation) is the run engine with a model (S-K6) and is reported as blocked in the plan. Requires `builder:write`; audited (`knowledge.plan.created`).

get.description: A plan of this organization (another organization's plan is a 404). Requires `builder:read`.

get.summary: A project compared with its template copy
get.description: The project's current files compared with the baseline its template copy recorded (what the copy wrote: path and checksum), so the comparison needs neither the template nor its files and keeps working after the template changes or is withdrawn. Lists added, modified and removed paths of the customer's own project, with exact counts. A project that was not copied from a template (or was copied before baselines were recorded) answers `linked: false`. Requires `builder:read`; 404 while `knowledge.generation` is off.

get.summary: What a model would receive for a plan
get.description: The bounded, ordered context assembled for a plan from the CURRENT state of the project: the platform policy for the adaptation mode (trusted), then the requirement, template facts, the file index and file contents by priority, each as a data block. Shows what was left out and why. Source of a template is sent only when the template's AI-processing permission allows it: contents of files that are still the template's are withheld otherwise (paths and sizes only); the customer's own work is always eligible. Nothing is sent anywhere by this call. Requires `builder:read`; 404 while `knowledge.generation` is off.

get.summary: Read-only execution timeline of a plan run
get.description: What the run of a plan did, step by step (S-AG3): the model turns (phase, tokens), the read-only tool calls of each (tool, redacted arguments, outcome, result size), the validation and apply steps, a fallback to the single-call adaptation and why, the limits used against their ceilings, and the outcome. Only the customer's own run data; nothing is written, no model is called, no file content is returned. A plan without a run answers mode NONE; a single-call run answers SINGLE_CALL. Requires `builder:read`; 404 while `knowledge.generation` is off.

post.description: Starts a run of the existing `webapp` kind with `input.templatePlanId`. With `agentic: true` (and `knowledge.agentic_generation` on, else 422) the run uses the read-only agent loop (S-AG3: plan, explore through the read-only tool gateway, propose, validate, apply; strict turn, token, time, cost and tool-call ceilings; checkpoints; falls back to the single call before anything is applied). Without it: ONE structured model call over the assembled context (metered, residency-checked, budget-capped, output secret-scanned, repair loop), then the proposed change set passes the same safety checks as every change and is committed on the AI branch `work/ai`, never on the main branch. Not the coding agent: no tool use, no on-demand file fetch, nothing is executed (D-46 open, D-21 blocks any run of the result). A plan starts once (409 otherwise). Requires `ai:write`, `app_builder.enabled` and `knowledge.generation`; audited. Model quality is NOT VERIFIED.

returnUrl.description: Where the customer returns after 3-D Secure; must be an allowed origin.

currentPeriodEnd.description: Exclusive: the next period starts here.

pendingCreditMinor.description: Credit applied to the next renewal.

dunningStage.description: Stage of the open dunning case (overdue, reminder_1, reminder_2, restricted, suspended, terminated_pending); null when nothing is overdue.

returnUrl.description: Where the customer returns after 3-D Secure; must be an allowed origin.

panelKind.description: hestia = ordered with the panel installed automatically (see GET /v1/compute/instances/{id}/panel).

holdReason.description: Why a held order waits: the provider has no capacity in the sold region. It is never moved to another region; cancel it with DELETE (no charge).

resumable.description: here: retry continues from Nuzm; server: the script on the server is re-run; support: not resumable on this server.

adminPasswordFile.description: Where the panel admin password was left ON the server (root only). It is never sent to Nuzm.

vaultRef.description: Metadata only: where the connection secret lives. The secret is never returned.

credentialVaultRef.description: Metadata only: the bucket-scoped credential lives in the vault. The secret is never returned.

runtime.description: A runtime id reported by a node

app.description: wordpress = Managed WordPress; its state is GET /v1/hosting/sites/{id}/wordpress.

certRef.description: A vault reference of an already uploaded certificate (custom).

privateKey.description: PEM private key (custom). Goes to the vault only; never returned or stored elsewhere.

phase.description: What the site showed at the last look (the install is driven by this, not by memory).

loginUrl.description: Set once the state is ready.

password.description: Generated, shown once, never stored in a table.

authCode.description: Write-only; stored in the vault and never returned.

url.description: The address to frame, on the isolated preview origin; its fragment carries the one-time demo session.

log.description: secret-redacted tail of the build log

vaultRef.description: a vault reference; key material is never accepted

aiProcessing.description: The template's permission to send its source to a model; false also when the template is no longer available.

plan.description: The agent plan text of the first turn, bounded.

args.description: Redacted arguments (secrets and file contents never shown).
